label: There is one and the same being that is…, from GOD_4 exists: there is something that is… and 2 more
meaning: Structural assembly/transcription only: take the existing GodExists witness g, apply the independent GodIsOne proposition to that SAME g, and apply GodHasClassicalAttributes to g. The result is the existing UniqueClassicalGodExists conjunction. This creates a modular argument-level consumer for existence and uniqueness proofs; it proves no attribute, nominal identification or philosophical premise and does not unpack the primitive HasClassicalAttributes field. No philosophical frontier closes merely from this assembly.
